name: @mkboard/desktop

scripts.dev: pnpm run prepare:runtime-defaults && pnpm run build:mcp && pnpm run rebuild:native && electron-vite dev
scripts.dev:debug: pnpm run prepare:runtime-defaults && pnpm run build:mcp && pnpm run rebuild:native && electron-vite dev --remoteDebuggingPort=9222 --sourcemap
scripts.start:web: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/register-ts-transpile-loader.mjs scripts/start-companion.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:runtime-defaults && electron-vite build && pnpm run build:mcp
scripts.dist:mac: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false pnpm run runtime:stage:mac && pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run build && PATH="$PWD/scripts/dmg-sync-compat:$PATH" electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false pnpm run runtime:stage:win && pnpm run rebuild:native:win && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('runtime/current',{recursive:true})" && electron-builder install-app-deps --platform=linux --arch=x64 && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.preview: pnpm run prepare:runtime-defaults && pnpm run build:mcp && pnpm run rebuild:native && electron-vite preview
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:desktop-updater && pnpm run test:elevenlabs-speech && pnpm run test:oss-byok-companion
scripts.dist:mac:oss: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('runtime/current',{recursive:true})" && pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run build && PATH="$PWD/scripts/dmg-sync-compat:$PATH" electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64:oss: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('runtime/current',{recursive:true})" && electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 --arch=x64 && node scripts/sign-native-modules.mjs && pnpm run build && PATH="$PWD/scripts/dmg-sync-compat:$PATH" electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:oss: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('runtime/current',{recursive:true})" && electron-builder install-app-deps --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never

description: MkBoard Open-Source Local-First AI Storyboard & Video Studio
